description: gr-dvbs2 is provided by GNU Radio DVB-S2 project. This GNU Radio out-of-tree module implements DVB-S2 and DVB-S2X transmission with variable or adaptive coding and modulation. Its README distinguishes this work from the constant-coding version already included in GNU Radio and provides a DVB-GSE test flowgraph. Geographic context: global (software applicability). Temporal coverage and spatial resolution are not established beyond the source details stated here. Source code and documentation are linked through the public repository; no software was installed or executed. The cited material was readable without payment. Reuse licence: GPL-3.0-or-later. It needs GNU Radio and the matching module branch; the included constant-coding functionality in GNU Radio is not the whole out-of-tree module. Potential simulation use: Test adaptive satellite broadcast coding and signal-chain configurations. For catalogue navigation, platform-gnu-radio offers related simulation context; this comparison does not assert an implemented connection.
